name: Lily Lucas
life: “I still remember signing a document after somebody tried to steer my wrist.” On Friday, near Juniper Street, Lily knows which of the west-side porches has a seat in the shade.
voice: I can sign only for myself now. Age has made everybody suddenly eager to speak on my behalf.
appearance: Lily has a thin scattering of white hair over the crown, a round face with a pronounced chin, and a favorite piece of clothing, an olive canvas jacket. It usually goes with a pen clipped inside the neckline. When somebody else has the floor, Lily squares up pieces of paper while thinking.
personality: Lily can be lavish with time and quite careful with cash. A free afternoon is sometimes the biggest gift Lily can afford to give, and family knows to take it seriously.
agenda: To sign only the papers genuinely understood.
family: Grey Iyer is Lily’s younger cousin. Lily makes room at the table. Grey brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *The million-dollar flat*, Grey says, “I offered an annuity and lost her attention when I couldn't tell her where she might live at ninety.”
connections: Amalia Keller (lease co-owner). Two generations of lease owners are each entitled to decide what can be signed.

reactions.situation: A creditor asks why the berth decision is taking so long
reactions.response: Lily gives the creditor an accurate update without exposing private family correspondence.

reactions.situation: An unfamiliar person asks for directions but cannot read the street signs
reactions.response: Lily draws the route by its turns and entrances and has the person show which turn comes first.
